fact: ICASEES states that after enumeration the fourth general population and housing census (RGPH-4) entered its processing phase, with data cleaning run May-September 2026 before tabulation and publication of results; no enumeration date is given, so the document's published date is used.

ICASEES held the restitution of the third phase of data cleaning of the RGPH-4, the country's first digital census, whose results are not yet final; no enumeration date is given, so the document's published date is used.

ICASEES says the RGPH-4 census data has been collected and is in cleaning and tabulation at a 2-5 October 2026 retreat in Boali, after the CTIR committee reviewed first provisional results on 23-25 September 2026.
ICASEES held a retreat at Boali on 2-5 October 2026 to clean and tabulate the data of the fourth general population and housing census (RGPH-4); no results are stated as published.
